mainEntity.name: What is included in a LankaLux journey?

acceptedAnswer.text: A private vehicle for your stay, airport pickup and drop-off, an English-speaking chauffeur-guide, and a custom itinerary. Hotels can be yours, arranged by LankaLux, or a mix of both.

mainEntity.name: Is the chauffeur also a guide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You travel with a dedicated private chauffeur-guide: one person who drives, helps with pacing, and shares local context. LankaLux does not describe this as a licensed national-guide qualification.

mainEntity.name: Are safari jeeps, trains and entrance fees included?

acceptedAnswer.text: Train tickets, safari jeep excursions, attraction entrance fees and optional activities are not included unless specifically stated. They can be arranged where possible, with applicable fees paid separately or on site.

mainEntity.name: Are the journeys on the website fixed packages?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. They are starting points. Choose a journey you like and LankaLux will reshape it around you.

mainEntity.name: Which vehicles can we travel in?

acceptedAnswer.text: LankaLux matches the vehicle to your group, luggage and route. Options include a Toyota Voxy, Toyota KDH vans and a sedan.

mainEntity.name: Can you review an itinerary we already have?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Send your current hotels or route and LankaLux will look at pacing, driving times, stops and activities, and tell you what it would change. There is no obligation.

itemListElement.name: Best time to visit Sri Lanka

mainEntity.name: When is the best time to visit Sri Lanka's south coast?

acceptedAnswer.text: The south and west are generally drier from roughly December to March. That is when Galle and Mirissa are the usual coastal chapter of a first visit.

mainEntity.name: When is the east coast better?

acceptedAnswer.text: The east is often calmer around the middle of the calendar year. A tailor-made itinerary can emphasise that coast instead of the south if those are your dates.

mainEntity.name: Can you visit Sri Lanka in the monsoon?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if you accept rain on some days and choose regions accordingly. We do not promise sunshine. We do plan indoor hours, park timing and a coast that is more likely to be kind.

itemListElement.name: How many days in Sri Lanka

mainEntity.name: Is 7 days enough in Sri Lanka?

acceptedAnswer.text: A week can work if you drop a region rather than rushing all of them. Culture plus coast, or hills plus a park, is kinder than trying to see the whole island.

mainEntity.name: Is 10 days enough for a first visit?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ten days is a sensible first visit: Cultural Triangle, Kandy and tea country, a wildlife park, then the south coast. LankaLux runs this shape as the Signature journey, always adjustable.

mainEntity.name: What can you do with 14 days in Sri Lanka?

acceptedAnswer.text: Two weeks lets you add a second park, more idle beach time, or a slower hill-country stay without stacking dawn starts.
